title: AI Farm Script Smart Targeting
features:
✔️ Auto Kill Zombies
Automatically finds and kills nearby zombies by locking onto the highest enemy and shooting it.

✔️ Auto Boss Kill
Detects bosses and automatically shoots them with perfect aim.

✔️ Auto Weapon Detection
Auto-detects your equipped gun—no setup needed.

✔️ Smart Target System
Avoids stuck zombies and switches targets automatically for smoother farming.

✔️ Anti-Stuck Logic
If a zombie doesn’t die for a while, it gets blacklisted to avoid wasting time.

✔️ Floating Above Enemies
Teleports you above zombies safely while farming to avoid taking damage.

✔️ Anti-AFK System
Prevents you from getting kicked for being AFK while auto farming.

✔️ Rayfield UI Included
Clean interface built with Rayfield UI – toggle, buttons and notifications.

✔️ Optimized Performance
Runs smooth with low lag, structured loops and smart checks.

✔️ Safe Auto Farm Toggle
Turn farming on/off anytime with one button.

✔️ Weapon Grab Button
Click "Get Weapon" if your gun isn't found automatically.
